content_sections.heading: HUDCO Executive Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: HUDCO has released 08 vacancies across two disciplines - Projects and Finance - for lateral-level executive posts. Discipline-wise, the Projects Discipline has 02 vacancies and the Finance Discipline has 06 vacancies, taking the total to 08 posts.

content_sections.heading: HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for HUDCO Recruitment 2026 is based on educational qualification, post-qualification executive experience, and age limit, as detailed below. Candidates should also possess relevant work experience: Projects Discipline candidates need hands-on experience in project appraisal, financial modelling, project development, project management, project monitoring, and regulatory compliance for Government, Private, or PPP infrastructure projects. Finance Discipline candidates need experience in financial management, budgeting, accounts, taxation, banking, credit appraisal, loan and recovery management, risk management, ERP implementation, and regulatory compliance. Experience is calculated from the date of acquiring the essential educational qualification. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks, NBFCs (including IFCs), multilateral organizations, or other financial institutions. Age will be reckoned as on 01.08.2026. Age relaxation is permissible up to 05 years for SC/ST candidates and 03 years for OBC(NCL) candidates. Age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen will be as per applicable Government norms. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: HUDCO offers pay on the IDA pay-scale (w.e.f. 01.01.2017), along with an approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) for each level. The CTC includes minimum Basic Pay, Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) at 55.7% of basic pay, HRA (30% of basic pay), Perks & Allowances (35% of basic pay), superannuation benefits (30% of basic pay), and Performance Related Pay (PRP) at maximum potential as per DPE slabs. In addition, employees get conveyance, company-leased accommodation (in lieu of HRA), medical reimbursement, loans and advances, group insurance, and other social security/functional benefits. Actual PRP payout depends on individual, team, and company performance, and IDA rates may change as notified by the Ministry of Finance.

content_sections.heading: HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is not refundable under any circumstances. HUDCO is not responsible for non-submission of an application due to delayed, failed, or truncated payments, payment to the wrong bank account, multiple payment attempts, or technical issues during submission. Candidates are advised to retain the original payment receipt or transaction reference for future verification.

content_sections.heading: HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for HUDCO Executive Recruitment 2026 is based solely on performance in a personal Interview; there is no written examination specified in the notification. Applications are first scrutinised for eligibility with respect to age, post-qualification experience, current pay level, and other notified criteria. Only prima-facie eligible applications are shortlisted for interview, generally in a ratio of 1:15 (subject to availability). If applications for a post are high, HUDCO may apply a higher shortlisting criterion than the specified minimum eligibility. Document verification is done before the interview; shortlisted candidates must bring all original certificates. The interview carries a total of 100 marks, split as: Job Knowledge (50 marks), Quality and nature of work experience (20 marks), and Overall personality (30 marks). Minimum qualifying marks in the interview: 70 marks for UR/EWS category, 60 marks for OBC-NCL category, and 50 marks for SC/ST category. Candidates can appear for the interview in Hindi or English.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for HUDCO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready at the time of application, as specified in the notification: Duly filled-in candidate format (available on the HUDCO website) Proof of Date of Birth (SSC/Tenth Class/Matriculation Certificate) Caste/category certificate, where applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/Ex-Servicemen) Disability certificate from a prescribed competent authority, where applicable, indicating type and percentage of disability Documents related to essential qualification (final degree certificate, mark sheets, CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula if applicable) Documents related to any additional qualifications A detailed write-up (not more than one page) on past work experience Experience certificate/relieving letter from past organisation(s) stating period of employment and nature of work Proof of pay-scale/CTC of current employer for the preceding one year, or payslips of the preceding 12 months if a CTC document is unavailable All documents should be self-attested, and applications with poor-quality, illegible, incomplete, or discrepant documents are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is HUDCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HUDCO Recruitment 2026 is a notification released by Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited for 08 lateral-level executive posts — Deputy General Manager (E-5), Assistant General Manager (E-4), and Senior Manager (E-3) - in the Projects and Finance disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HUDCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 08 total vacancies: 02 in the Projects Discipline and 06 in the Finance Discipline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HUDCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application along with the prescribed fee is 16.09.2026, till 18:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HUDCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Projects Discipline posts require a Bachelor's degree in Civil/Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Mechanical engineering with minimum 60% marks. Finance Discipline posts require CA/CMA or a two-year full-time MBA/PG Diploma with Finance specialization with minimum 60% marks (except for CA/CMA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HUDCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years for Deputy General Manager (E-5), 40 years for Assistant General Manager (E-4), and 35 years for Senior Manager (E-3), as on 01.08.2026, with applicable age relaxation for SC/ST, OBC-NCL, and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for HUDCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹1,500 for UR, EWS, and OBC-NCL category candidates. SC, ST, and PwBD category candidates are exempt from the application fee.
